newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates ease to a 21.875 percent close.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates ease to a 21.875 percent close.

text.p: Hungary's overnight rates remained on a slight downward slope on Wednesday in what dealers said was average trade in a liquid market.
"There is plenty of money, we are at the beginning of the (banks' two-week) reserve period," said Zoltan Kalman of Hypo-Bank Hungaria.
Overnight rates closed at 21.875 percent after being traded between 21.75 to 22.25 percent, dealers said.
They expect the rates to maintain current levels or ease slightly over the next few days in routine trade. -- Denes Albert, Budapest newsroom +36 1 327 4040
